Name: Kenneth's Cookie Clicker Crops
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Cookie Clicker Crops[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A little crossover that brings the garden from Cookie Clicker into Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds all 34 plants from the Cookie Clicker garden minigame as real crops you can grow in Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- 34 crops including Bakers Wheat, Bakeberry, Chocoroot, Meddleweed, Whiskerbloom, Chimerose, Queenbeet, Juicy Queenbeet, Shriekbulb, Ichorpuff, Crumbspore, Doughshroom, Wrinklegill and the rest of the set[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Giant crops supported for the bigger plants like Queenbeet, Juicy Queenbeet and Bakeberry[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced growth times, seasons, and sell prices[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Seed shop location can be changed in GMCM and defaults to Shop4[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for changing shop location[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Full requirements list is shown in the Requirements tab above.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Install Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Unzip the mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Should work fine with most other content mods.[/b][/size]
